values.note: 'Effective January 1, 2024: The Asaph and County Bridge Campgrounds must be reserved through the Pennsylvania State Parks and Forests Reservation website.' Seven-night limit; check-in and check-out 3 pm.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/tioga/camping ('Effective January 1, 2024: The Asaph and County Bridge Campgrounds must be reserved through the Pennsylvania State Parks and Forests Reservation website') + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('reserved 11 months in advance to noon of the day of arrival', 'A camping permit will be valid for no more than seven consecutive nights'), read 2026-10-20

note: Developed drive-in state forest campground (Tioga State Forest) near Grover, along a small stream. 15 pull-in sites, twelve of them listed for vehicles up to 40 ft; non-flush toilets, no hookups, water or dump station. Must be reserved through the PA reservation system (since January 2024).
summary: Confirmed no hookups, reservable on ReserveAmerica 11 months ahead to noon, 7-night limit. Changed site count 14 -> 15 (ReserveAmerica lists County Bridge Campground 001-015). Added max 40 ft (12 sites), no pull-throughs, non-flush toilets, no showers/water/dump, reservation required, open year round. Note corrected (15 sites, most fit 40 ft, so the 'verify 23-ft fit' caveat is answered). Fees left as recorded (DCNR state forest rate).
